answer.question: What does TEAM International do for banks and financial services companies?
answer.text: TEAM International is a financial software development company that builds, modernizes and runs software for banks, payment companies, investment firms and insurers: digital banking and payments, core and legacy modernization, automation and data, and insurance platforms. Allica Bank, Nomo and Swiss Re are among the institutions our teams have worked for.
answer.segmentsIntro: IT services for banks and financial services companies, focused on mid-size institutions that need enterprise-grade engineering.

focus.title: Financial services IT solutions we build and run
focus.intro: Custom financial software development in four areas, each one already in production for financial clients.

items.title: Digital banking and payments
items.text: Banking software development for digital and challenger banks: mobile banking app development, neobank app development, onboarding with KYC, payment software development and payment gateway development.
items.proof: In production: the digital banking app of a UK-licensed neobank (Nomo, since 2021); delivered: payments and back-office automation for Allica Bank (2021–2024).

items.title: Core, trading and legacy modernization
items.text: Core banking modernization without a big-bang cutover, trading software development and trading platform development, and wealth management software development on modern, cloud-native architecture.
items.proof: In production: a strangler-fig migration of a U.S. remittance company's 20-year-old core to cloud microservices, and digital-asset subsystems for a Swiss online bank (since 2019).

items.title: Automation, data and compliance
items.text: RPA in banking and RPA in finance, intelligent automation in banking for documents and onboarding, lending software development, and financial data management for reporting and regulators.
items.proof: In production: deal documentation cut from up to two weeks to 15 minutes for a vehicle-finance platform, and data integration for a global private-markets investment firm (since 2016).

items.title: Insurance platforms
items.text: Insurance software development for carriers, MGAs and insurtechs: policy, quoting and claims, portals and AI assistants, as an insurance software development company or alongside your team.
items.proof: In production: a claims rule engine and auto insurance product for a P&C insurtech platform, and an AI insurance-advisor chatbot for a UK small-business insurer.

delivery.title: Your language, your market, your time zone
delivery.text: North American banks and financial companies work with our Medellín delivery center; European clients work with our teams in Ukraine. All locations are certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and we work under GDPR.

items.q: What does a financial software development company do?
items.a: A financial software development company designs, builds, integrates and supports the software banks, payment companies, investment firms and insurers run on. Financial services software development has to meet security, audit and regulatory requirements from the first release, which is why TEAM International builds them into every step.

items.q: What financial software development services does TEAM International offer?
items.a: Four areas: digital banking and payments; core, trading and legacy modernization; automation, data and compliance; and insurance platforms. As a banking software development company we offer banking software development services as dedicated squads or project delivery. For fintech start-ups and scale-ups, see our fintech page.

items.q: Can you modernize our core banking or payments platform without a big-bang migration?
items.a: Yes. We use incremental patterns such as the strangler fig: new services take over one function at a time while the legacy core keeps running. We are doing this today for a U.S. remittance company with 20 years of business logic.

items.q: How do you handle security and regulatory requirements?
items.a: Security reviews, audit trails and automated testing are part of every release, and we work closely with your risk and compliance teams; for a Swiss online bank our team follows up regulator audit findings. All TEAM locations are certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and we work under GDPR.

items.q: Which financial institutions has TEAM International worked with?
items.a: Allica Bank (published case study; Allica won Top Tech Team UK at the Banking Tech Awards with TEAM engineers on the team), Nomo and Swiss Re, plus a Swiss online bank, a U.S. remittance company, a global private-markets investment firm and several insurers. Other names are shared on request.

items.q: How is AI used in banking today?
items.a: The most practical uses of AI in banking are document processing, onboarding and service assistants. Accenture's 2026 banking trends research found that nearly 70% of bank IT spending goes to maintaining legacy systems and meeting regulatory demands, so automation and modernization free the budget AI needs.

items.q: Do you work with mid-size banks, lenders and insurers?
items.a: Yes. Mid-size financial institutions are our focus; they get the same practices we use for clients such as Swiss Re. We also provide custom banking software development and IT services for financial services teams that need extra capacity.

With a Financial Discovery & Modernization Assessment. From there you choose dedicated squads, project delivery or support; custom financial software development with TEAM means one accountable team, not a pool of contractors.
